Hi Neha — great demo; thanks. Answers inline below.

1) Hosted vs Dedicated/Private: For the evaluation we are fine with Hosted provided we can get a 30-day log retention window and an export of request/response audit logs. If human review data is in scope, we need the ability to opt-out of storing those prompts.

2) SLO expectations: For short completions (support triage) we'd like P95 <= 300ms if possible. For generation (recommendations) 500ms P95 is acceptable. If we need slower response time for higher throughput, call that out.

3) Endpoints: prefer separate endpoints — classification (low-latency, small tokens), generation (slightly higher latency, longer TTL for KV cache), embeddings (separate). That will help us map rate limits and monitoring per route.

4) Admins / SSO: yes, two people need admin access initially (me + Lina Park). We use SAML/SO for SSO.

Traffic profile clarification: Steady: 35-45 req/s. Peak: ~110-130 req/s for short window (2–6 hours) during product launches. Average tokens per request ~ 250 (including response).

Happy to proceed with Hosted pilot — would like a short operations call with Karthik next week to walk through endpoint mapping and rate ceilings.

Thanks,
Chris Jordan
Head of Platform | Payly
